999008199.text:
久しぶりに訪れたわ、クア州。
……あら、あそこにいるのは

localizations.en: It's been a while since I last visited Kur Province. ...Oh, is that who I think it is over there?

999008199.text: やっほー、二人とも
あれー！　ザスキアさんだー！
ザスキアさん！　お久しぶりです

localizations.en: Saskia! It's so good to see you again!

999008199.text:
（クア州沿岸に現れた頂獣ウェルテックス討伐の際、
　力を借りた異邦人の錬金術士たち）

localizations.en: (When the Apexi Weltex appeared off the coast of Kur Province, these wanderer alchemists lent us their strength.)

999008199.text:
（彼女たちの助けもあって、レスナは錬金術士として
　大きく成長し、人々の錬金術への信用も高まったわ）

localizations.en: (With their help, Resna grew tremendously as an alchemist, and people's trust in alchemy deepened as well.)

999008199.text: あなたたち、ここで何をしているの？

localizations.en: What are you two doing here?

999008199.text:
復興のお手伝いです。でもそろそろ落ち着いてきた
ので、どこか行こうかって話してました

localizations.en: We've been helping with the reconstruction efforts. But things are finally settling down, so we were just talking about heading somewhere else.

999008199.text:
ザスキアさんは何してるんですか？
なんだか素敵な衣装ですけど！

localizations.en: What about you, Saskia? That's a lovely outfit you're wearing!

999008199.text:
少し早いけど新年の挨拶よ。
あなたたちにも、はい、お守り

localizations.en: I know it's a bit early, but I'm making my New Year's rounds. Here, charms for you two.

999008199.text: わー！　ありがとうございます！

二人とも、ウェルテックスとの戦いの時はありがとう。
助かったわ

localizations.en: Thank you both for your help during the battle with Weltex. You really saved us.

999008199.text:
いえ！　みんなを守ることができたのは、
ザスキアさんの錬金術があってこそでした

localizations.en: Not at all! We were only able to protect everyone because of your alchemy, Saskia.

999008199.text: そう言えば、最近レスナさんに会ってないね

localizations.en: Come to think of it, we haven't seen Resna in a while.

999008199.text: うん。なんだか忙しいみたいだからね

localizations.en: Yeah. She seems pretty busy these days.

999008199.text:
ええ。でも二人に会えたらレスナも嬉しいと思うから、
よかったら今度アトリエに顔見せに行ってあげて

localizations.en: She is. But I'm sure Resna would be thrilled to see you two, so please stop by the atelier sometime.

999008199.text:
そうだ二人とも、おみくじ引かない？
私が調合した、錬金術おみくじよー

localizations.en: Oh, that's right! Would you two like to draw a fortune slip? They're my special alchemical fortunes.

999008199.text: わぁ、引きたいです！

えーっと、「ジュゲル密林に探しものあり」！？
む、虫がいっぱいいるとこだ……

localizations.en: Let's see... 'What you seek lies in Jugel Jungle'?! B-but that place is crawling with bugs...

999008199.text:
私は、「近年稀に見る金運」……！
見て見てスーちゃん！　私、金運がいいみたい！

localizations.en: Mine says 'Exceptional financial fortune this year'...! Look, look, Suelle! I've got great luck with money!

999008199.text:
おぉっ！　つまり、あたしとリディーが一緒に
密林に行けば、一攫千金かもってことだよね！？

localizations.en: Ooh! So that means if we go to the jungle together, we might strike it rich, right?!

999008199.text:
よしっ！　次の目的地は密林！　お宝見つけたら、
レスナさんに自慢しに行こ！　くふふふふ……！

localizations.en: Alright! Our next stop is the jungle! And when we find treasure, we'll go show it off to Resna! Ehehehehe...!

999008199.text: ふふ。お宝見つけたら、私にも教えてね？

localizations.en: Hehe. If you find any treasure, make sure to tell me about it, okay?

999008199.text:
それじゃあ私は行くわね。
二人とも、レスナのことよろしくね

localizations.en: Well then, I should get going. Please keep looking after Resna for me, you two.

999008199.text: はい！
